name: component-diagnostics-rigidly-coupled-storage-is-rejected-as-high-index
source:
ThermalMass   M1(C=5000, T0=400)
ThermalMass   M2(C=3000, T0=300)
connect(M1.port, M2.port)
DYNAMIC d(method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10)
END

error.message: High-index DAE: storage states 'm1.port.t' and 'm2.port.t' are rigidly coupled (directly equated) — index ≥ 2. Lump them into one storage element, or insert a small resistance/compliance between them.
